title.doc: Page title: what this page is about.

eyebrow.doc: Small label above the title, such as an area or team.

asOf.doc: When the data was current. ISO date or date-time. Shown on every card.

source.doc: Where the data came from. Shown on every card.

marking.doc: Banner text, such as Synthetic data, Draft or Internal.

locale.doc: Locale for numbers and dates. Default en, which writes Jan 31, 2026. Use en-GB or en-AU for 31 Jan 2026.

currency.doc: ISO 4217 code for currency formats. Default USD.

views.doc: One page-wide switch over a column.

switches.doc: Viewer controls to show in the header.

method.doc: Rows for the Method panel: [[term, explanation], ...]. Derived columns are added automatically.

field.doc: Column the switch filters. A pipeline opts in with where: {column: "$view"}.

label.doc: Name of the control, such as Line.

all.doc: Label for the unfiltered choice. Default All.

rows.doc: One array per row, values in column order.

from.doc: Source table: a data table or another derived table.

where.doc: Keep rows where column equals a value, is in a list, or matches "$view".

add.doc: New columns from row arithmetic, such as {"excess": ["pos", ["sub", "wip", "target"]]}. Operations are listed below.

group.doc: One row per distinct value. With no agg, each row gets a count.

agg.doc: Aggregates per group or bin, such as {"units": ["sum", "qty"]}.

bin.doc: Bin this numeric column. Needs step. Adds bin, lo, hi and count.

sort.doc: Column to sort by. Prefix with - for descending.

top.doc: Keep this many rows and fold the rest into one Other row.

other.doc: Label for the folded row. Default Other.

cum.doc: Adds running total, share and cumulative share for this column.

value.doc: A scalar. first, last, min and max may also pick text or a date, such as the top row's name.

format.doc: Number format, or date, day or month for a date. Default int.

label.doc: What the number is. Sentence case, no colon.

unit.doc: Unit shown after the value, such as units or days.

hero.doc: The one number the page leads with. At most one.

detail.doc: A computed second line, such as a share of the whole.

status.doc: Thresholds on the value. Shows a labelled status chip.

text.doc: Words after the number, such as of all WIP.

from.doc: The comparison value. The change shown is value minus from.

label.doc: What it is compared with, such as vs last week.

good.doc: Which direction is good. Default none (shown neutral).

y.doc: Column to draw, in row order.

field.doc: Column to test. Default: the bar's value, or a histogram's bin start. Omit on a KPI tile.

direction.doc: Whether values above or below a threshold trigger it. Default above.

strict.doc: true: a level applies only past its threshold, not at it. Default false (at or past).

labels.doc: Words for each level used, such as {"warning": "Above target band"}. In a table column, normal names the rest.

title.doc: States the finding, not the measure. With a view switch, give {"*": default, "view value": text}.

chart.doc: A chart. Give chart or table, not both.

table.doc: A table. Give chart or table, not both.

note.doc: One line of context under the chart.

type.doc: Compare categories, or actual against target.

y.doc: Value column. Bars always start at zero.

orient.doc: h (default) for categories, v for time buckets.

xFormat.doc: Format for x values, such as day or month. Default text.

target.doc: Target, drawn as a tick on each bar: a column, or one number for every bar.

band.doc: [low column, high column] drawn as a shaded range behind each bar.

highlight.doc: Category or list of categories to draw in the accent, or max or min.

status.doc: Thresholds that colour bars and add a shape and a legend.

sort.doc: Default none, which keeps row order.

labels.doc: Display names for columns, such as {"wip": "WIP"}. Use the keys band and target to name those marks.

data.doc: Table to draw, rows in time order.

y.doc: One to four value columns. The first is emphasised.

band.doc: [low column, high column] drawn as a shaded range.

zero.doc: Force the value axis to include zero.

colors.doc: emphasis (default): first series accent, others grey. categorical: one hue each.

xFormat.doc: Format for x values. Default text.

labels.doc: Display names for columns. Use the keys band and target to name those marks.

type.doc: Shape of a distribution. Feed it a bin pipeline.

status.doc: Thresholds on the bin start that colour bins.

xFormat.doc: Format for bin edges. Default int.

format.doc: Number format for counts. Default int.

unit.doc: Unit of the counted thing, shown in tooltips.

xUnit.doc: Unit of the binned measure, such as days.

labels.doc: Display names for columns. The key bin names the bins in the table view.

type.doc: Which few contributors make up most of a total.

data.doc: Table to draw. Sorted for you, largest first.

cut.doc: Share at which to draw the cut line. Default 0.8.

sort.doc: Starting sort column. Prefix with - for descending.

limit.doc: Rows to show. A caption states how many were left out.

label.doc: Header text. Default: the column name in words.

unit.doc: Unit added to the header in brackets.

status.doc: Show a labelled status chip instead of the number.
